note: Frozen surface of the retired Next.js MCP server (app/api/mcp/route.ts + lib/mcp/tools.ts). The FastAPI server at services/agent must remain a superset: same tool names, same required inputs, no silently narrowed schema. tests/mcp-parity.test.ts pins this file against services/agent/app/tools.toml.
instructions: RobinCalls is the permanent record of Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). Use scan_token to get a fresh, hash-chained risk Verdict on any token; get_verdict and lookup_deployer read the persistent record; get_methodology returns the published scoring formula. Scores are deterministic — code, not oracle.

tools.name: scan_token
tools.title: Scan a token
tools.description: Run the full RobinCalls Verdict on a Robinhood Chain token: CRITICAL kill-shot checks, weighted risk checks, and a layered honeypot simulation. Returns the score, tier, per-check results, and (if persistence is on) the hash-chain ledger stamp. Deterministic and reproducible.

address.description: The token contract address on Robinhood Chain (0x + 40 hex).

tools.name: get_verdict
tools.title: Get a recorded verdict
tools.description: Look up a previously-issued Verdict from The Ledger by its numeric id. Returns the recorded score, tier, checks, and hash-chain links — proof of what was said and when.

tools.name: lookup_deployer
tools.title: Look up a deployer
tools.description: Check a deployer wallet against the RobinCalls persistent record: confirmed rugs, dead launches, and total extracted. This cross-session memory is what stateless scanners cannot provide.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.title: Get the scoring methodology
tools.description: Return the published, versioned RobinCalls scoring formula: tier bands, CRITICAL kill-shot overrides, and every weighted check with its weight and source. Every score is re-derivable from this.
